result.note: Tested the format and venue of the 25th India–China Special Representatives talks; skipped Xi's visit as it is only expected.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the 25th round of India–China Special Representatives talks held in August 2026:
items: India was represented by its National Security Advisor and China by its Foreign Minister.
The talks were held in New Delhi, weeks ahead of the BRICS summit.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: NSA Ajit Doval met Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing, not New Delhi. New Delhi is where Xi Jinping was expected for the BRICS summit on 12-13 September 2026. The Special Representatives mechanism is the main forum for the unresolved border, and this was the first such meeting in a year.
questions.source: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval arrives in Beijing on Monday for the 25th round of Special Representatives (SR) talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, the first such meeting in a year and the main forum for the two countries' unresolved border.
